subject: Frontend Focus suggestion: a container-sized wall preview
text:
Hi Frontend Focus team,

A demo suggestion for your CSS coverage: I make Take The Wall, a shared webpage with a free designer for messages and projects. Its desktop/mobile preview lives inside a dialog, using container sizing and cqw typography so it responds to the preview frame rather than the browser viewport.

Try it: https://www.takethewall.com/?take=1
Source: https://github.com/sariserhan/takethewall/blob/main/app/globals.css

The live wall changes owner with each activated takeover. Previewing is free; publishing uses paid checkout or reviewed free email entry. This is an editorial suggestion, not an advertising inquiry.

Take The Wall
contact@takethewall.com
